content.title: About
content.content: Frozen corn that has been pre‑cooked with vegetable oil is a convenient ready‑to‑heat product. Corn provides carbohydrates, dietary fiber, and a modest amount of protein, while the added oil boosts its energy content and flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Corn is one of the world’s most widely cultivated grain crops.
Freezing preserves most B‑vitamins and antioxidants such as lutein.
Cooking with oil improves absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins, including vitamin A present in corn.
Corn is commonly used as a side dish, in salads, soups, and Asian stir‑fries.
There are several corn varieties: sweet, yellow, white, and semi‑white.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Readily digestible carbohydrates supply quick energy, useful for active lifestyles.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Dietary fiber supports digestive health and promotes satiety.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Lutein and zeaxanthin help protect eye health against age‑related changes.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Thiamine, niacin, and folate aid in energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Healthy fats
items.content: The added vegetable oil provides omega‑6 fatty acids.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: The oil increases the product’s calories, so portion control is advisable.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to corn.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some versions contain added salt; check the label if you monitor sodium intake.

items.title: Glycemic index
items.content: Corn has a moderate glycemic index, which can affect blood sugar levels.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the frozen corn in the microwave, on a skillet, or in a steamer for 3‑5 minutes. Serve as a side dish, add to salads, soups, tacos, or vegetable mixes. Sprinkle with fresh herbs, cheese, or your favorite spices.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the package in the freezer at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. Once opened, use within 1‑2 months. Do not thaw and keep at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
